sources.excerpt: Honey Moon - Sweet Overdrive Published on August 30, 2013 Aleks K Production overdrive pedal picture by Brett Kingman Information Aleks K Production Honey Moon Sweet Overdrive is a very versatile pedal with unlimited capabilities. The five adjustment knobs and filter switch allow you to model your guitar sound in a variety of ways. You can make it sound soft and melodious, or heavy and aggressive. The pedal allows you to play in any style: from light blues to hard-rock. The Honey Moon is true bypass with next to no noise, even at max drive. The unit features a booster, filter and two distinct Overdrives, all in one box. Features: Volume. Designed to adjust the output volume level from the pedal to your amplifier. Tone. Allows you to set the desired balance between high and low frequencies. Even at max position the tone is very warm and pleasing to the ear. Filter. Allows you to express certain frequency range. The filter control displaces the range on the frequency spectrum, from lows to highs, in addition making the sound incredibly melodic and smooth. Drive 1. A smooth and hard overdrive. Even at low drive 1 settings the pedal gives you a thick and solid sound. This is a type of overdrive well suited for a variety of rock styles. Drive 2. A light and bright overdrive. This is a type of overdrive well suited for light compositions in a style of country, blues, pop and more. The Drive 1 and Drive 2 are independent of one another, each featuring a different type of an overdrive. The 2 drives can either be used separately or together. By combining the 2 drives together you can easily simulate any type of an overdrive, perfectly suitable for either rhythm or solo parts. By setting the Drive 1 and Drive 2 simultaneously to near or max position, you will get an incredibly thick and powerful overdrive. The 2 drive knob system together with Tone and Filter allows you to easily make the pedal sound just the way you want it. Thank you for buying Honey Moon Sweet Overdrive! Our products - that is traditional Canadian quality. We are confident that the Honey Moon will help its owner's musical creativity and bring much joy and pleasure.
